key.name: language
key.description: Its code: de, en, es, fr, it or ru. Empty, or a language whose speech model is not installed: the first of the user's languages with one, else English.

key.name: talk-brain
key.description: A server's address (https://…/v1: the VibeOS Agent gateway, an OpenAI-style API; the phone enrolls with its device id), or a GGUF file's path to answer on the phone itself. Empty, or a file that is not there: the first model in vibeos-dictate/brain under the user's data directory or the system's.

key.name: talk-voice
key.description: A Piper, Kokoro or tiny-voca ONNX model's path. Empty, or a file that is not there: the voice in vibeos-dictate/voices/LANGUAGE under the user's data directory or the system's (for Russian tiny-voca, in its tiny-voca directory).

key.name: talk-voice-name
key.description: The voice file's name in the model's voices directory (af_heart). Empty: the first there is. Piper voices have one speaker each and ignore it.

key.name: talk-voice-gender
key.summary: Whether a man or a woman speaks
key.description: "Voice" in Agent's settings, for a voice that has both (Russian's tiny-voca); from the next sentence on. Voices with one speaker ignore it.

key.name: talk-speed
key.description: "Speech rate" in Agent's settings: 1.0 is the voice's own pace, up to 3.0 for people used to fast speech.

key.name: talk-verbosity
key.description: "Answers" in Agent's settings: short (a sentence), normal (one to three), or detailed. The model is told it.

key.name: cue-sounds
key.description: A short sound when Agent starts listening, starts working on an answer, is done, or failed; only when the phone's sound is on.

key.name: cue-haptics
key.description: A short vibration when Agent starts listening, starts working on an answer, is done, or failed; not in Silent mode.

key.name: talk-speak
key.description: Off, the replies are only written: the speaker button in Agent's bar.

key.name: talk-listen-again
key.description: Once a reply has been spoken to its end, Agent listens for the next thing the user says, as in a conversation.

key.name: talk-private
key.description: Agent's replies play only in headphones or earbuds when they are connected; on the speaker they are short, with no names, numbers or message texts read aloud.

key.name: announce-calls
key.description: Agent says who is calling, even when it is not open, and listens for "answer" or "decline". Open, it always does. It starts with the session while this is on.

key.name: quiet-hours
key.description: A time range, "HH:MM-HH:MM" (it may go over midnight), in which Agent says nothing and plays no cue on its own; '' for none.

key.name: quiet-calls
key.description: Calls are still announced in the quiet hours.

key.name: debug-log
key.description: Agent records each turn whole on the phone, and nowhere else: what it sent to the model, what came back, each tool's call with its arguments and result, the times and the errors. Its newest 100 turns are kept, 5 MB at most.

key.name: outward-confirm
key.summary: Sending a message or placing a call
key.description: countdown: once Vibe has read back a message or a call to someone the user named, it goes after 3 seconds unless the user says or taps cancel. wait: it goes only when the user says or taps send. A recipient Vibe had to guess, a locked phone or a voice that is not the owner's always waits.

key.name: access-calls
key.description: "Phone calls" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: access-messages
key.description: "Messages" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: access-contacts
key.description: "Contacts" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: access-calendar
key.description: "Calendar" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: access-alarms
key.summary: Agent can use alarms and timers
key.description: "Alarms and timers" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: access-settings
key.summary: Agent can use the phone's settings
key.description: "Settings" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: access-apps
key.description: "Apps" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: access-files
key.description: "Files" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: access-camera
key.description: "Camera" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: access-location
key.summary: Agent can use the phone's location, maps and navigation
key.description: "Location and maps" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: access-web
key.description: "Web" in Agent's settings. Off, Agent is told it has no access to it, and says so when asked.

key.name: first-run
key.summary: Vibe's introduction is still to come
key.description: While true, Vibe introduces itself the next time the session starts or the app opens (its language, speed, what it may use and the voice sample), and the key goes false once that is over or skipped.

key.name: voice-match
key.summary: Vibe only answers the owner's voice
key.description: "Only answer my voice" in Vibe's Voice match settings, turned on when a voice sample is saved. While it is on and a sample is on the phone, a command in another voice runs nothing the settings below ask the owner's voice for.

key.name: voice-match-strictness
key.summary: How close a voice must be to the owner's
key.description: "How close a match", from 0 (lenient) to 100 (strict); 50, balanced, needs a 75 % match.

key.name: voice-match-everyday
key.summary: The owner's voice for everyday questions
key.description: The time, the weather, alarms and timers answered only to the owner's voice, while Voice match is on.

key.name: voice-match-personal
key.summary: The owner's voice for personal information
key.description: Messages, the calendar and contacts read out only to the owner's voice, while Voice match is on.

key.name: voice-match-actions
key.description: Calling, sending, deleting and changing settings only for the owner's voice, while Voice match is on.
